Discussion The present study is the first wide survey about ET practice in Turkey and the second large survey in Europe (Table 7). In the study, All of participating units was performing ET and they were mostly managed by anesthesiologists (93.0%) (Tables 1 and 5). Moreover, anesthesiolo- gists were also director of all cardiovascular surgery, surgical and neurological ICUs.
